title: 😮 Priya pats the only circle-time drum... then three kids want it? #kids #rhymes
title_alts: 🤔 Why does Priya's circle rhyme stall with one drum and three kids? #kids #poems
😬 Priya and the one drum three kids want... whose turn is it? #kidsrhymes #storytime
refrain: Tap tap, clap clap, two!
description_hook: Three kids, one drum, and a circle rhyme that keeps falling apart. Priya's fix comes out of her own bag.

characters.name: Priya
characters.description: six years old, two short black braids tied with red bands, mustard yellow kurta, gap in her front teeth

scenes.narration: At circle time Priya wants the only drum first. Her rhyme is ready.
scenes.caption: गोल घेरे में प्रिया पहले वह अकेला ढोल चाहती है। उसकी तुकबंदी तैयार है।
scenes.image_brief: Priya, a six-year-old girl with two short black braids tied with red bands, wearing a mustard yellow kurta, sits cross-legged on a round woven mat in a classroom corner. One red hand drum rests on the mat in front of her knees. Four other children sit around the edge of the mat. Warm morning light falls through the tall windows.

scenes.narration: Priya pats the drumskin round and round. Her palms find a bouncing sound. 'Tap tap, clap clap, two!' she sings.
scenes.caption: प्रिया ढोल पर गोल-गोल थाप देती है और गाती है, थाप थाप, ताली ताली, दो!
scenes.image_brief: Priya, six years old with two short black braids tied with red bands and a mustard yellow kurta, pats the red hand drum with both flat palms, her mouth open mid-song. The woven mat and the other seated children fill the space behind her. Morning light from the windows catches dust in the air.

scenes.narration: Say it with Priya: Tap tap, clap clap, two!
scenes.caption: प्रिया के साथ बोलो: थाप थाप, ताली ताली, दो!
scenes.image_brief: Priya, six, in her mustard yellow kurta with two red-banded braids, holds both palms above the red hand drum and looks out at the viewer, inviting them in. The children around the mat clap in time. Bright even classroom light.

scenes.narration: Two more hands land on Priya's drum. Three want one. The beat breaks and the song comes undone.
scenes.caption: दो और हाथ प्रिया के ढोल पर आ जाते हैं। तीन बच्चे, एक ढोल। ताल टूट जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Three pairs of small hands grab at the single red hand drum on the woven mat, and Priya in her mustard yellow kurta with two red-banded braids leans back as the drum tilts. Song cards and a tambourine lie scattered on the mat. The other children look startled. Cool daylight from the classroom windows.

scenes.narration: Priya flips her lunchbox over and taps it with a pencil. Now two drums answer.
scenes.caption: प्रिया अपना टिफ़िन उलटकर पेंसिल से बजाती है। अब दो ढोल बजते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Priya, six, in a mustard yellow kurta with two red-banded braids, kneels beside an upside-down blue metal lunchbox and taps it with a yellow pencil while another child pats the red hand drum. The two drums face each other across the woven mat. Warm light from the windows.

scenes.narration: Clap along: Tap tap, clap clap, two!
scenes.caption: साथ में ताली बजाओ: थाप थाप, ताली ताली, दो!
scenes.image_brief: Priya, six, in her mustard yellow kurta with two red-banded braids, claps twice above the upturned blue lunchbox while facing the viewer. The red hand drum and the other children sit in the circle around her. Bright classroom light.

scenes.narration: The lunchbox knocks light. The drumskin hums right. Priya keeps the time.
scenes.caption: टिफ़िन हल्के से खटकता है। ढोल धीमे गुनगुनाता है। प्रिया ताल संभालती है।
scenes.image_brief: Priya, six, in a mustard yellow kurta with two red-banded braids, taps the upturned blue lunchbox softly with the yellow pencil, her eyes on the other child's red hand drum. The classroom is calm and the mat is tidy. Long golden late-afternoon light lies across the floor.

scenes.narration: Priya feels bigger than the whole circle. Tap tap, clap clap, two!
scenes.caption: प्रिया को पूरे घेरे से बड़ा महसूस होता है। थाप थाप, ताली ताली, दो!
scenes.image_brief: Priya, six, in her mustard yellow kurta with two red-banded braids, stands at the middle of the woven mat with the blue lunchbox under one arm and the yellow pencil raised, smiling wide. The other children sit clapping around her. Warm golden light through the tall windows.

title: 😤 Zuri counts ten jumps before the bell... who else grabs the rope? #kids #poems
title_alts: 🧐 Why must Zuri stop her jump count in the courtyard this week? #kids #rhymes
😳 Zuri and the courtyard rope she cannot get back... now what? #kidsrhymes #play
refrain: Hop two, hop three, hop me!
description_hook: Zuri had ten jumps and a rope, until the big kids claimed it for a pulling game. What she does with a stub of chalk is the whole trick.

characters.name: Zuri
characters.description: seven years old, short coiled black hair under a green headband, blue school pinafore, scuffed white sneakers

scenes.narration: All week Zuri wants ten straight jumps before the bell. The courtyard rope waits by the gate.
scenes.caption: पूरे हफ़्ते ज़ूरी घंटी से पहले दस कूद चाहती है। रस्सी गेट के पास पड़ी है।
scenes.image_brief: Zuri, a seven-year-old girl with short coiled black hair under a green headband, wearing a blue school pinafore and scuffed white sneakers, stands in a paved courtyard beside a coiled skipping rope near an iron gate. Chalk marks and a school bell are on the wall behind her. Early sunlight lies across the paving stones.

scenes.narration: Zuri skips to six, then eight. She chants at the rattling gate, 'Hop two, hop three, hop me!'
scenes.caption: ज़ूरी छह, फिर आठ तक कूदती है और गाती है: दो कूद, तीन कूद, अब मैं!
scenes.image_brief: Zuri, seven, green headband, blue school pinafore, scuffed white sneakers, is mid-air over a turning skipping rope in the paved courtyard, her mouth open counting. Two other children turn the rope ends near the iron gate. Bright morning sun and a short hard shadow under her.

scenes.narration: Say it with Zuri: Hop two, hop three, hop me!
scenes.caption: ज़ूरी के साथ बोलो: दो कूद, तीन कूद, अब मैं!
scenes.image_brief: Zuri, seven, in her blue school pinafore with a green headband, stands still in the paved courtyard with the rope slack in one hand, facing the viewer and calling out. The iron gate and the painted wall are behind her. Clear morning light.

scenes.narration: Big kids take the rope for a pulling game. Zuri's count drops to zero. So she chalks four boxes on the stones.
scenes.caption: बड़े बच्चे रस्सी छीन ले जाते हैं। ज़ूरी की गिनती रुक जाती है। वह चॉक से चार खाने बनाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Four older children haul the skipping rope away in a line across the paved courtyard while Zuri, seven, green headband and blue school pinafore, crouches on the stones drawing four chalk boxes. A stub of white chalk is in her fingers. Midday light with sharp shadows.

scenes.narration: Hop with Zuri: Hop two, hop three, hop me!
scenes.caption: ज़ूरी के साथ कूदो: दो कूद, तीन कूद, अब मैं!
scenes.image_brief: Zuri, seven, green headband, blue school pinafore, scuffed white sneakers, hops in the air above the chalk boxes in the courtyard with both arms out, calling to the viewer. The older children and the rope are further off by the iron gate. Bright open daylight.

scenes.narration: Chalk dust settles. The boxes go grey. Zuri hops slower, counting each one.
scenes.caption: चॉक की धूल बैठ जाती है। खाने धुँधले पड़ते हैं। ज़ूरी गिनकर धीरे कूदती है।
scenes.image_brief: Zuri, seven, in her blue school pinafore with a green headband, hops slowly from one faded chalk box to the next in the quiet courtyard, chalk dust on her knees. The skipping rope lies forgotten by the iron gate. Soft late-afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Zuri feels the courtyard belongs to her feet. Hop two, hop three, hop me!
scenes.caption: ज़ूरी को लगता है आँगन उसके पैरों का है। दो कूद, तीन कूद, अब मैं!
scenes.image_brief: Zuri, seven, green headband and blue school pinafore, stands in the middle of her four chalk boxes in the empty courtyard with both fists up, grinning. Faint chalk lines spread around her sneakers. Warm low evening light across the stones.

title: 😊 Mateo tips out the whole crayon tin for one blue... who has it? #kids #rhymes
title_alts: 🤨 Why can Mateo not finish the moon line before lunch ends? #kids #poems
🥹 Mateo and the blue crayon in another girl's fist... now what? #kidsrhymes #storytime
refrain: Blue for moon, moon for blue!
description_hook: One blue crayon, two children, and a moon that needs colouring before lunch ends. Mateo pays for it with words.

characters.name: Mateo
characters.description: six years old, straight dark brown hair cut in a fringe, red striped t-shirt, bandaid on his left knee

scenes.narration: Two lines left, and Mateo needs blue for the moon. Lunch ends soon.
scenes.caption: दो पंक्तियाँ बाकी हैं और मातेओ को चाँद के लिए नीला चाहिए। लंच जल्दी ख़त्म होगा।
scenes.image_brief: Mateo, a six-year-old boy with straight dark brown hair cut in a fringe, wearing a red striped t-shirt and a bandaid on his left knee, kneels at a low craft table with a half-finished poem on paper, a big round moon outlined but not coloured. A paper wall of other children's poems is behind him. Cool light from a side window.

scenes.narration: Mateo tips the crayon tin flat. Greens, one chewed black. 'Blue for moon, moon for blue!' he says.
scenes.caption: मातेओ रंगों का डिब्बा उलटता है, बस काला बचा। वह कहता है: चाँद को नीला, नीले को चाँद!
scenes.image_brief: Mateo, six, with a dark brown fringe and a red striped t-shirt, tips a tin of crayons out flat across the craft table. Green crayons and one chewed black stub roll across his poem page. His mouth is open, chanting. Bright window light on the spilled crayons.

scenes.narration: Chant with Mateo: Blue for moon, moon for blue!
scenes.caption: मातेओ के साथ बोलो: चाँद को नीला, नीले को चाँद!
scenes.image_brief: Mateo, six, in his red striped t-shirt with a dark brown fringe, holds up the chewed black crayon stub and speaks straight at the viewer across the craft table. The uncoloured moon on his poem page lies under his other hand. Even classroom light.

scenes.narration: The last blue crayon sits in another girl's fist. Her whale wants it too.
scenes.caption: आख़िरी नीला क्रेयॉन दूसरी लड़की की मुट्ठी में है। उसकी व्हेल को भी वही चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A girl at the other end of the craft table grips the last blue crayon in her fist over a drawing of a whale, while Mateo, six, red striped t-shirt and dark brown fringe, watches from his seat with his poem page in front of him. The crayon tin and scattered greens lie between them. Daylight from the window.

scenes.narration: She needs a rhyme. Mateo trades her tail and sail for the blue crayon.
scenes.caption: उसे एक तुक चाहिए। मातेओ नीले के बदले दो तुक दे देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Mateo, six, red striped t-shirt and dark brown fringe with a bandaid on his left knee, leans across the craft table holding up two fingers as he offers rhyming words, while the girl passes him the blue crayon over her whale drawing. Warm light on both pages.

scenes.narration: Two crayons, two poems, one tin. Mateo fills his moon in.
scenes.caption: दो क्रेयॉन, दो कविताएँ, एक डिब्बा। मातेओ अपना चाँद भर देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Mateo, six, red striped t-shirt and dark brown fringe, colours the big moon blue on his poem page while the girl beside him colours her whale blue with the second crayon. One crayon tin sits between them on the craft table. Bright midday light.

scenes.narration: Chant again: Blue for moon, moon for blue!
scenes.caption: फिर बोलो: चाँद को नीला, नीले को चाँद!
scenes.image_brief: Mateo, six, in his red striped t-shirt with a dark brown fringe, taps the blue crayon on the craft table and calls out to the viewer, his finished blue moon on the page beside his hand. The girl's whale drawing lies next to it. Clear classroom light.

scenes.narration: The blue goes soft and low. Mateo writes slow.
scenes.caption: नीला रंग हल्का पड़ता है। मातेओ धीरे-धीरे लिखता है।
scenes.image_brief: Mateo, six, red striped t-shirt and dark brown fringe, presses the worn blue crayon lightly to write the last small line under his blue moon, his shoulders low. The craft table is quiet and the crayons are back in the tin. Soft late light from the window.

scenes.narration: Mateo feels proud of his moon. Blue for moon, moon for blue!
scenes.caption: मातेओ को अपने चाँद पर गर्व होता है। चाँद को नीला, नीले को चाँद!
scenes.image_brief: Mateo, six, in his red striped t-shirt with a dark brown fringe and a bandaid on his left knee, holds up his finished poem with the blue moon in front of the paper poem wall, smiling. The girl pins her whale poem beside his. Warm afternoon light.

title: 🥹 Hana gets one turn at her rain poem... then the words stop? #kids #poems
title_alts: 😯 Why does Hana stall halfway through her porch rain poem? #kids #rhymes
🤗 Hana's rain poem, one turn each, two lines missing... now what? #kidsrhymes #bedtime
refrain: Rain on the roof, rain on me!
description_hook: Hana gets one turn on the porch and loses her middle verse halfway through. The way she asks for help changes the whole poem.

characters.name: Hana
characters.description: five years old, black bob with a yellow hair clip, pink cardigan over pyjama trousers, cloth-covered poem book

scenes.narration: On the porch Hana wants her rain poem said right. One turn each, then lamps out.
scenes.caption: बरामदे में हाना अपनी बारिश की कविता ठीक से सुनाना चाहती है। एक-एक मौका, फिर बत्ती बंद।
scenes.image_brief: Hana, a five-year-old girl with a black bob and a yellow hair clip, wearing a pink cardigan over pyjama trousers, stands on a wooden porch holding a cloth-covered poem book, three cousins sitting on the steps behind her. Rain falls on the tin roof and drips off the edge. One oil lamp glows on the porch rail at night.

scenes.narration: Hana starts strong. Rain on the tin, rain in the bin. The middle verse goes blank.
scenes.caption: हाना ज़ोर से शुरू करती है। टिन पर बारिश, डिब्बे में बारिश। बीच का बंद भूल जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Hana, five, black bob with a yellow clip and a pink cardigan, recites with her chin up on the wooden porch, one hand out toward the falling rain. Her three cousins sit cross-legged on the steps watching. Rain streams off the tin roof edge. Warm lamplight on the wet boards.

scenes.narration: Say it with Hana: Rain on the roof, rain on me!
scenes.caption: हाना के साथ बोलो: छत पर बारिश, मुझ पर बारिश!
scenes.image_brief: Hana, five, with a black bob and yellow clip in her pink cardigan, faces the viewer on the porch with the closed poem book held against her chest, her lips shaping the words. Rain and the tin roof are behind her. Soft lamplight.

scenes.narration: Her cousins grab for the next turn. Two lines gone, no second go.
scenes.caption: चचेरे भाई-बहन अगली बारी के लिए हाथ उठाते हैं। दो पंक्तियाँ गुम, दूसरा मौका नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: Three cousins on the porch steps lean forward with their hands up, wanting the next turn, while Hana, five, black bob, yellow clip and pink cardigan, stands with the poem book open and her place lost. Rain still falls past the tin roof edge. Low lamplight and long shadows.

scenes.narration: So Hana asks the porch to answer her. She calls, 'Rain on the roof, rain on me!'
scenes.caption: तो हाना सबसे जवाब देने को कहती है। वह पुकारती है: छत पर बारिश, मुझ पर बारिश!
scenes.image_brief: Hana, five, black bob with yellow clip and pink cardigan, holds both hands out to her cousins on the porch steps, calling a line for them to answer back. The cousins open their mouths to reply. Rain on the tin roof behind them. Lamplight across all their faces.

scenes.narration: Answer Hana back: Rain on the roof, rain on me!
scenes.caption: हाना को जवाब दो: छत पर बारिश, मुझ पर बारिश!
scenes.image_brief: Hana, five, with a black bob and yellow clip in her pink cardigan, cups one hand behind her ear on the porch, facing the viewer for the answer. Her cousins are mid-call behind her. Warm lamplight and rain beyond the rail.

scenes.narration: Six voices carry the verse she lost. The rain slows on the tin.
scenes.caption: छह आवाज़ें उसकी भूली पंक्ति उठा लेती हैं। टिन पर बारिश धीमी पड़ती है।
scenes.image_brief: Hana, five, black bob, yellow clip and pink cardigan, stands quietly on the porch while her cousins chant the verse together, the rain thinning on the tin roof. The poem book rests closed on the rail. Dim soft lamplight.

scenes.narration: Hana feels held up by every voice. Rain on the roof, rain on me!
scenes.caption: हाना को हर आवाज़ का सहारा महसूस होता है। छत पर बारिश, मुझ पर बारिश!
scenes.image_brief: Hana, five, with a black bob and yellow clip in her pink cardigan, sits on the top porch step between two cousins with the poem book on her knees, smiling with her eyes shut. Rain drips slowly off the tin roof. Gentle lamplight at night.

title: 😌 Farid rings the bell that starts the rhyme parade... then what? #kids #rhymes
title_alts: 🧐 Why does Farid's rhyme parade stop behind the smallest boy? #kids #poems
🥳 Farid and the bell at the front of the rhyme parade... who rings it? #kidsrhymes #play
refrain: Ring once, step twice, go!
description_hook: Farid wanted to be the one ringing the bell at the front of the parade. Then the whole line stopped behind him.

characters.name: Farid
characters.description: eight years old, short curly black hair, grey school shirt with rolled sleeves, one untied shoelace

scenes.narration: Farid wants to ring the bell that starts the rhyme parade. The line waits behind him.
scenes.caption: फ़रीद तुकबंदी परेड शुरू करने वाली घंटी बजाना चाहता है। पीछे कतार खड़ी है।
scenes.image_brief: Farid, an eight-year-old boy with short curly black hair, wearing a grey school shirt with rolled sleeves and one untied shoelace, holds a small brass handbell at the head of a line of younger children in a school corridor. Paper rhyme banners hang along the wall. Bright light from the corridor windows.

scenes.narration: Farid rings once, steps twice. Small shoes follow, two by two. He chants, 'Ring once, step twice, go!'
scenes.caption: फ़रीद एक बार घंटी बजाकर दो कदम चलता है। नन्हे जूते साथ चलते हैं: एक घंटी, दो कदम, चलो!
scenes.image_brief: Farid, eight, short curly black hair, grey school shirt with rolled sleeves and one untied shoelace, rings the brass handbell and steps forward while six younger children march two by two behind him down the corridor. Paper banners hang overhead. Clear daylight through the windows.

scenes.narration: March with Farid: Ring once, step twice, go!
scenes.caption: फ़रीद के साथ चलो: एक घंटी, दो कदम, चलो!
scenes.image_brief: Farid, eight, in his grey school shirt with short curly black hair, holds the brass handbell up beside his face and calls out to the viewer in the corridor. The line of younger children waits behind him. Bright corridor light.

scenes.narration: The smallest boy loses the beat and the line stops. So Farid ties the bell to that boy's wrist with his shoelace.
scenes.caption: सबसे छोटा बच्चा ताल भूल जाता है, कतार रुक जाती है। फ़रीद घंटी उसकी कलाई पर बाँध देता है।
scenes.image_brief: The parade has bunched up in the corridor with children bumping into each other, while Farid, eight, curly black hair and grey school shirt, kneels and ties the brass handbell to the smallest boy's wrist with his own shoelace. One of his shoes is loose on his foot. Flat daylight from the windows.

scenes.narration: Step with Farid: Ring once, step twice, go!
scenes.caption: फ़रीद के साथ कदम मिलाओ: एक घंटी, दो कदम, चलो!
scenes.image_brief: Farid, eight, short curly black hair and grey school shirt, marches in place at the back of the corridor line and beckons the viewer to step with him. Ahead of him the smallest boy's wrist carries the brass bell. Bright light along the banners.

scenes.narration: The bell rides ahead now, small and bright. Farid walks last, keeping the count.
scenes.caption: घंटी अब आगे बजती है। फ़रीद सबसे पीछे चलकर ताल गिनता है।
scenes.image_brief: The smallest boy leads the corridor parade with the brass bell shining on his wrist, and Farid, eight, curly black hair, grey school shirt and one loose shoe, walks last, counting on his fingers. The other children move in even steps. Warm late light down the corridor.

scenes.narration: Farid feels taller at the back of the line. Ring once, step twice, go!
scenes.caption: फ़रीद को कतार के पीछे भी ऊँचा महसूस होता है। एक घंटी, दो कदम, चलो!
scenes.image_brief: Farid, eight, in his grey school shirt with short curly black hair and one loose shoe, stands at the back of the finished parade looking ahead at the small boy with the bell, chest up and smiling. The banners and children fill the corridor. Golden late afternoon light.

title: 😟 Tilly reads the long poem again before bed... whose crayon is that? #kids #poems
title_alts: 🤨 Why does Tilly's poem page vanish under red wax tonight? #kids #rhymes
🥲 Tilly and the poem page her little brother scribbles on... now what? #kidsrhymes #bedtime
refrain: One scribble, two scribbles, sing!
description_hook: Tilly's library poem page disappears under a toddler's crayon the night before it goes back. What she does with the loops is copyable tonight.

characters.name: Tilly
characters.description: seven years old, wavy ginger hair in a high ponytail, freckles across her nose, star-print pyjamas

scenes.narration: By bedtime Tilly wants the long poem word perfect. The library book goes back tomorrow.
scenes.caption: सोने से पहले टिली लंबी कविता पूरी याद करना चाहती है। किताब कल लौटानी है।
scenes.image_brief: Tilly, a seven-year-old girl with wavy ginger hair in a high ponytail and freckles across her nose, wearing star-print pyjamas, sits on a rug in a reading nook with a thick library poem book open on her knees. Her little brother, a three-year-old boy in blue pyjamas, sprawls beside her with a red crayon and paper. One lamp glows on a low shelf at night.

scenes.narration: Tilly reads one verse while her brother loops his crayon. 'One scribble, two scribbles, sing!' she calls.
scenes.caption: टिली एक बंद पढ़ती है, भाई क्रेयॉन घुमाता है। वह गाती है: एक लकीर, दो लकीरें, गाओ!
